parts.questionStem: 6. If S = {square, rectangle, circle, rhombus, triangle}, list the elements of the following subset of S.
parts.exactEnglish: The set of shapes which have 5 sides.

mathematicalNotes: Q6(i): Both a square and a rhombus have 4 sides of equal length; a general rectangle only guarantees equal opposite sides.
Q6(ii): Among the listed shapes in S, only the circle is defined by a centre and radius r.
Q6(iii): A triangle has interior-angle sum 180°; quadrilaterals in S have interior-angle sum 360°.
Q6(iv): A 5-sided polygon is a pentagon, which is not in S, so the subset is the empty set ∅ (not {∅}).
